scope: Idle namespace-loss and combined namespace/database-loss pilots on development images. Eight engine/family/loss combinations in an isolated Kubernetes 1.37.0 amd64 cluster.
limitations: The control plane and installed release survive namespace loss; these runs do not meet the separate-cluster restoration requirement.
Measured durations include namespace/database restoration and a fresh approved change, but no replacement cluster provisioning.
No in-flight Apply, five-minute backup lag, final-profile or final-artifact qualification.
Private encrypted backups and keys remain locally restricted pending durable storage and custody.
The temporary OCI registry was removed after the completed proofs; its artifact references are historical and are not a retained portable recovery kit.

runtime.scope: Observed development-drill runtime; no dedicated-host capacity qualification.

rebuild.archiveOnly: Old plans, chunks, approvals and execution records retain their original identities in the encrypted backup. They are not re-created as authorization for new UIDs.
